name: Postwise — AI Email
description: A sea-glass landing page for Postwise, an AI email assistant: a hero lit by a drifting teal, mint and apricot glow, a hairline numbers band, a deep-lagoon copilot section with floating notes and drifting signals, three how-it-works cards, a clickable feature deck, persona tabs, a team dashboard over a sunlit desk, a results bento, a duotone customer-story carousel, monthly/yearly pricing with a border-beam plan, an FAQ, a wall of love and poster-type calls to action.
designedFor: AI email, inbox and productivity tools
SaaS products that need the full set: numbers, how it works, stories, pricing and FAQ
Sales, support and communication platforms with several audiences to speak to
Seeing a stacked card deck, an Embla carousel, parallax and a border beam built as editor-controllable components
